name: Anthony Wise
source:
Leader of the criminal "Crimson Scorpion" organization. 
Rumor is that he is 50 years old. 

It's been 10 years since the organization started the blood-stained war between various large and small forces. 

Now, he rarely appears in public, due to fear of assassination.
